findings.summary: Cordelia Fishbar is open at 550 Morse St NE. The near-duplicate replacement-cordelia-fishbar-washington-dc ledger record resolves to this same restaurant and should be deduplicated by the coordinator rather than modeled as a second location.

The complete current boundary contains 72 food and nonalcoholic products. Eight frozen seasonal/legacy rows are stale; current official sections add dinner, brunch, raw-bar, dessert, zero-proof, coffee, and exact-Toast kids or sold-out products missing from the frozen slice.

No comprehensive current item-by-allergen matrix or restaurant-level cross-contact policy was found after all four required search classes. Toast allergy items are request modifiers, not mappings. Only direct positive allergens supported by current restaurant descriptions or product identity were retained; unsupported negatives and inferred may-contain claims were excluded.
